spec.description: Is every component up, is anything alerting, is the app serving users, and is there room to run? Grafana's home page; every other P2 dashboard is in the dropdown above.

spec.title: Probes down
spec.description: Health probes failing right now (16 services, every 15 s).

spec.title: Targets down
spec.description: Metrics endpoints Prometheus cannot scrape right now.

spec.description: Alert rules firing now. Section 2 lists them.

spec.title: Requests/s
spec.description: Every API request, all endpoints (5 min rate).

spec.title: p95 (< 2 s)
spec.description: 95% of requests finished faster than this (15 min window). Target: under 2 s.

spec.title: API 5xx %
spec.description: Share of requests that failed on the server. Above 1% for 5 min fires HighErrorRate.

spec.title: LLM failures
spec.description: LLM calls that failed (15 min, all providers). The next provider answers instead, but costs more.

spec.title: VM mem free
spec.description: Memory still available in the Docker VM (node-exporter). Below 15%, starting more (kind, builds) will swap.
